title: Onderzoek in en rondom de open school 1977-1981
authors: Hinnekint, H., Jorg, T., Stichting proefprojecten open school * Zeist, Jansen, G., Universiteit van Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Kohnstamm Instituut, Linden, F.J. van der, Hoogveld instituut * Nijmegen (primary investigator)
contributors: Stichting proefprojecten open school * Zeist (data collector)
descriptions: Evaluation of adult education in the experimental program 'Open School' / several tests for educational achievement, intelligence, personality, structure etc. / attitude questionnaires were used at several stages of participants' career in the program / analysis was focused on separate groups, officially recruited groups, spontaneous groups and individual participants.
